A ticket (RITM0033075) was issued under the item "Once DA split is clicked, the number of split entries cannot be changed," but it was not resolved. Since this is an error that requires debugging due to its root cause, I will internally discuss the issue and, as requested, proceed with issuing an incident ticket.

Documents :  eTR-K1-24000875 , eTR-K1-24000904 

Overview :
The user initially set the travel days to 3, which resulted in 3 DA split entries. However, after modifying the travel days to 3.5, it’s necessary to adjust the entries to 4 items.

Problem : 
Even if the document is set to RFI in Draft status, the split button does not reappear on the user's screen for a DA item once it has been split. This means that the PIDSKR team cannot make adjustments, and they are left with no choice but to request document modifications from Singapore for each case.

Solution : 
It is essential to either allow the DA split function to be re-executed multiple times in Draft document status or provide a feature to reset previously split DA items.

Background: Converting a Pre-Project preserves the link and the history of the client and its related opportunity. Sometimes the customer will place an order for the main project ( The one that is created from Conversion ) , the cost incurred during the pre project needs to reflect on the main project. 

The expected: Is that when the project is converted the cost should reflect on the converted major/ minor  project under the project structure wbs.

See example of how  a  converted project should be
 
50 Albert Street Preproject- https://hussmann-nz.lightning.force.com/lightning/r/Milestone1_Project__c/a152u000002ozQ0AAI/view

(Converted ) Project - 50 Albert Street - Base Build (Major Project )
https://hussmann-nz.lightning.force.com/lightning/r/Milestone1_Project__c/a155j00000KPZqGAAX/view

Problem : 
User created : Pre project :    BNZ Link Drive Branch Network Upgrade Pre-Project
https://hussmann-nz.lightning.force.com/lightning/r/Milestone1_Project__c/a155j00000PwtHZAAZ/view

When the project was converted to Major the costs from the pre project have not transferred to the converted project 
Converted Project -BNZ Link Drive
https://hussmann-nz.lightning.force.com/lightning/r/Milestone1_Project__c/a155j00000Qr0e2AAB/view

Potential  Root Cause : This pre-project sub task is a variation task  and the status is under Approved instead of Open. So during the cloning, the status is default to Approved and you are not allowed to clone a new task as "Approved" stage.
https://hussmann-nz.lightning.force.com/lightning/r/Milestone1_Sub_Task__c/a175j000002iikuAAA/view

There is a validation in place that may be causing the cost to not be carried onto the converted project :https://hussmann-nz.lightning.force.com/lightning/setup/ObjectManager/01I2u0000008bDx/ValidationRules/03d2u000000CeeT/view

The uploaded file should appear in the "Notes & Attachments" field which I marked in red above, just like the warranty data created directly from Salesforce (SFDC) , like the following capture
Problem (Issue) : Even on the customer portal account page, you cannot see documents that have been uploaded. When the warranty registration has been carried out, there is only a check mark in the caption "Proof of Purchase Uploaded".
 
2). We have created a Dashboard Report on Warranty Registration data in the public report with the name "Report Warranty PGI” in Salesforces (SFDC). In this report you can retrieve the required data, such as Customer Name, Purchase Date, Purchase Store, Customer Address, etc., 
Problem (Issue) : but in the Salesforce Report Builder, there is no option to retrieve document files uploaded by the customer to their customer portal account. 

3). We attaching (Please see the attachment) an example of export data from the warranty report that was created earlier, in the form of an excel file. To find out whether the warranty registration was registered from the customer portal or not, you can filter it in column "J" or with the header "Source of Registration", with the information "Customer portal" 

4). In the warranty registration data, we can find out whether the warranty was registered via the customer portal or not, by looking at the Source of Registration field or the "Created by" field in the warranty details in Salesforce, 
Problem (Issue) :  but in the customer account data, we cannot You can know for sure whether the account has been registered with a customer portal account or not, because there is no specific information that can provide information on this, such as in the warranty registration data.
